title: Profile ids, avatar correlation, threat-actor handle lists and organisation code footprint (P107, P114, P195, P359)
owner: batch p2-G05-2 (profile_id_extractor helper, avatar_correlation, threat_actor_handles, org_code_footprint, org_code_secrets; rules p2g05_avatar_reuse, p2g05_gravatar_email_match)

attributes.avatar_dhash: 16-hex 64-bit dHash of the whole avatar image (9x8 grayscale difference hash on Pillow; never face detection or biometric analysis, P114)
attributes.avatar_sha256: SHA-256 of the avatar image bytes as served (the image itself is never stored, P114 cond 4)
attributes.avatar_facts: avatar image facts {format, width, height, bytes, stddev32, frames_used, upload_date_hint}: no pixels, no thumbnail (P114 cond 4/9)
attributes.avatar_ignored: why an avatar is not an identity signal: 'flat' (grayscale stddev < 6) or 'placeholder:<platform>' (bundled default/placeholder dHash list, P114 cond 5)
attributes.profile_ids: stable ids, creation date, counters and flags extracted from a profile page the caller already fetched: {scheme, source_page, fields} (P107; no request made)
attributes.linked_accounts: linked accounts found on profile (owner-written, attacker-controlled when the subject is an actor): list of {platform, handle, url, source_page}; expand=False (P107 cond 4)
attributes.profile_personal: names, e-mails, phones and location shown on a profile page (owner-written, POSSIBLE): never auto-pivoted into person_name, breach or stealer modules (P107 cond 6)
attributes.forum_handle_lists: scraped forum user lists where the same handle appears: list of {forum, title, status, list_date}; a weak signal, handle collisions are common (P195)
attributes.code_orgs: source-code and package organisations found for a company or handle: list of {provider, login, url, state candidate|confirmed, basis, website_host} (P359 cond 2)
attributes.code_repos: most recent public repositories of confirmed organisations (forks without own commits skipped): list of {provider, full_name, url, pushed_at, fork, archived} (P359 cond 4)
attributes.code_packages: packages and images published by confirmed organisations {npm, pypi, docker}: names and dates only (P359 cond 1)
attributes.code_member_counts: public member count per confirmed organisation {'<provider>:<login>': count}; member usernames are never listed by default (P359 cond 4)
attributes.code_secret_scan: deep secret scan summary {repos_scanned, repos_skipped [{repo, reason}], files_scanned, secrets}: current tree only, values never kept (P359 cond 5/6)

tags.same_avatar: two accounts show the same avatar image (whole-image dHash): an identity signal that never proves the same person (P114)
tags.common_image: the same image is used by more than three unrelated accounts (logo, meme, stock image): not an identity signal (P114 cond 6)
tags.third_party_disclosure: a secret of a third party (supplier, customer): route it to the disclosure workflow, keep it out of shared reports (P359 cond 7)

relations.has_avatar: profile (username, account, profile URL, e-mail) -> the URL of its avatar image
relations.linked_account_on_profile: profile page -> account the owner linked on it (owner-written, expand=False, P107)
relations.email_on_profile: profile page -> e-mail address shown on it (owner-written, expand=False, never auto-sent to breach/stealer modules)
relations.phone_on_profile: profile page -> phone number shown on it (owner-written, expand=False)
relations.name_on_profile: profile page -> display/real name shown on it (owner-written, expand=False, never auto-pivoted into person_name modules)
relations.link_on_profile: profile page -> other link the owner put on it (owner-written, never fetched by the extractor)
relations.code_org: company, domain or handle -> forge/registry organisation URL (candidate unless confirmed by an owned website or the analyst, P359)
relations.org_member: organisation -> public member username (listed on demand only, expand=False, P359)
